_about: Chapter 1: ten calls, each changing one thing. Run them with `npm run model:try`, read stage-01/usage.md, then CHANGE ME: swap in your own prompts and settings and run again. Fields: prompt, system, model (claude-haiku-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5), effort (low, medium, high), thinking (true or false), max_tokens, stream (true or false). Call 6 is cut off on purpose.

calls.system: You answer in exactly two short sentences.

calls.prompt: Who won the most recent FIFA World Cup?
